implemented: Vault path resolution now rejects dot/dot-dot aliases, Windows-reserved segments on Windows, intermediate symlink traversal and non-directory parents.
VaultStore exposes a pre-temp-write fault seam so disk-full and permission-loss simulations preserve the original file, incoming bytes and failed-write metadata.
The portable vault-safety failure matrix records non-destructive outcomes for disk, permission, concurrency, deletion, rename, partial sync, placeholder, symlink, case and Unicode classes.
limitations: The fault hooks simulate disk-full and permission loss; real filesystem quota, ACL and power-loss behavior remains platform-specific and pending.
Only macOS arm64 ran locally; Windows/Linux matrix execution and reference Obsidian reopen/differential tests remain pending.
Cloud placeholder behavior is represented as a do-not-follow safety outcome but has not been exercised against a real cloud-provider placeholder.
